intent: Test daily post-catalyst continuation and intraday early-mover hypotheses without selecting eventual winners. Numeric values are predeclared exploratory choices, not optimized or empirically justified parameters.

scope.market: US exchange-listed ordinary common shares only, including eligible historical inactive/delisted names

source_contract.universe: Provider-scoped security ID and historical ordinary-share/listing intervals with evidence valid at each cutoff. Current asset status, ticker equality, missing map or today's reconstructed membership is insufficient. Retain every rejected, missing and eligible candidate.
source_contract.availability: Each input requires its original value/revision, source hash, effective time and separately evidenced available_at_ns. Unknown original publication/availability is not inferred from SEC acceptance or bar event time. For newly captured historical rows, use actual response observation conservatively, which excludes them at historical cutoffs.
source_contract.timestamps: Exact integer UTC nanoseconds; local schedule uses America/New_York and an explicit exchange calendar. Positive source timestamps only; reject bool, float, naive/local ambiguous timestamps and unsupported precision. Strict comparisons must never round availability downward.
source_contract.catalyst: SEC form8-K only (exclude8-K/A), explicit parsed Item1.01, unique accession plus source hash. This category denotes a material definitive agreement, not necessarily favorable news. Parser absence/ambiguous item means unknown; do not infer missing1.01 from silence. Require a complete supported item index to label a non-catalyst control.
source_contract.duplicates: One accession triggers at most one signal per lane/security; multiple share classes keep security identities but group by issuer/event for splitting. Revisions retained by hash/available time; no amendment silently replaces original event. Subsequent corrections can affect later decisions only.
source_contract.corporate_actions: All prior-window prices and share volumes must share a documented cutoff-consistent split basis; dollar volume is matched price times share volume. Never combine adjusted volume with raw prices or apply a future split to an earlier signal without a frozen causal normalization rule. Unknown action, identity, dividend currency/unit, or delisting outcome blocks empirical accounting and remains retained.
source_contract.minute_bars: Timestamp is interval start, not completion. Eligible feature_end_ns is the minute interval end; actual available_at_ns must also be <= decision. Completed bars may arrive late; use only known revision. Missing/zero-activity/invalid bars are quarantined, never filled. Do not infer a halt from missing data.
source_contract.quotes: Require bid>0, ask>=bid, supported quote condition, nonzero displayed sizes and as-known source sequence. At intraday decision and every entry quote age<=1000ms and full quoted spread<=100bps. Daily16:15 formation uses completed bars only; do not demand a regular-session quote then. Missing quote/halt/session evidence blocks fill.
source_contract.session: Use actual venue calendar. Skip half-days and any session not390regular minutes in v1; retain excluded rows. During known halt, unknown status or missing required minute window, no new entry. Never assume continuous tradability.

daily.hypothesis: A newly available Item1.01 event plus completed-session positive price/volume reaction is followed by positive five-session continuation relative to controls.
daily.catalyst_window: First availability strictly after the prior regular close and <=current16:15 cutoff; event_session_index denotes that decision-session availability window, not economic event date.
daily.price_return: completed regular close[t]/prior regular close[t-1]-1, split-consistent
daily.relative_volume: completed regular-session volume[t]/median complete regular volume over prior20sessions, common split basis
daily.rank: descending relative_volume, then descending price_return, then stable security ID lexicographically
daily.earliest_entry: Next full regular session09:35:00ET; first eligible quote >=max(target time,decision+60s); never signal close
daily.exit: First eligible quote at/after15:55ET on fifth holding session, counting entry session as1; no earlier price stop or profit target

intraday.hypothesis: Known Item1.01 plus an early +5% reaction and unusual elapsed-session volume predicts positive next60minute price movement relative to controls.
intraday.price_return: latest fully completed known regular minute close/prior regular close-1, split-consistent
intraday.relative_volume: cumulative completed volume from09:30 to decision/median same elapsed-minute cumulative volume across prior20fullsessions; all20matchedwindows required
intraday.rank: first qualifying decision per security/session, then descending relative_volume, descending price_return and security ID for simultaneous competition
intraday.earliest_entry: First eligible quote >=decision+60s; never at triggering minute open/close
intraday.exit: First eligible quote at/after min(actual_entry+60minutes,15:55ET); no earlier price stop or profit target

portfolio.allocation: Each accepted fill targets10% start-of-session NAV times leverage; maximum10concurrent positions and gross<=leverage*NAV. No same-security overlap within lane; lanes evaluated as separate portfolios, never silently combined. Cash unallocated.
portfolio.sizing: Whole shares floor(target_notional/entry_ask); max1% cumulative actual eligible traded volume over entry minute and max10% contemporaneous displayed ask size; no future-minute liquidity. Require quote/trade evidence before feasible size is assigned.

costs.bid_ask: Buy at supported ask plus impact; sell at supported bid minus impact. Full spread is paid by crossing, not deducted again.
costs.financing_convention: ACT/365 on positive borrowed cash over actual elapsed UTC time; hypothetical sensitivity, not broker rate.

portfolio.leverage_semantics: Fixed separate sensitivities, never automatic leverage optimization or Alpaca margin/Elite entitlement. At2x/4x assume initial margin1/leverage and maintenance25% gross marked exposure. Fees may make4x immediately violate maintenance; retain refusal or forced-liquidation loss.
portfolio.margin_and_halts: At every supported event mark, equity/exposure<0.25 requests liquidation at next eligible bid plus stress costs. No fictitious fills through halts. If no eligible exit within5minutes, retain unresolved exposure and block promotion; never mark unknown delisting proceeds zero.
portfolio.loss_gates: Stop new risk for that simulated lane after start-of-dayNAV drawdown>=3% or total peak-to-trough drawdown>=20%; manage existing positions. Resume daily stop next fullsession; total drawdown remains stopped for experiment.

labels.open_to_high_1d: regular_high[t]/regular_open[t]-1; ex-post excursion only, never attainable fill or selection feature
labels.entry_to_exit: supported exit_mid/entry_mid-1 for declared lane horizon; separate from executable bid/ask/cash P&L
labels.first_crossing: Earliest valid observed future quote/trade satisfying its named ratio>=3; interval-censored at available resolution, never infer exact crossing from daily high.
labels.unknowns: Invalid units, missing prices, unproven action basis or incomplete horizon produce explicit unknown/censored labels, not zero or negative. IPO lacking prior close is excluded from v1 and counted.
labels.separation: Each named label has its own +200%boolean. Open-to-high, prior-close-to-high, five-session close and attainable returns must never be collapsed into one mover flag.

controls.event_only: Same eligible universe and lane timing/catalyst age; remove price/relative-volume thresholds; rank stable security ID.
controls.price_volume_only: Same thresholds/timing without catalyst requirement; keep catalyst presence as descriptive flag.
controls.non_catalyst_matched: At each treated cutoff choose1 eligible security with confirmed no1.01availability in the same lane event window, same floor(log2(prior_close)) and floor(log10(median_dollar_volume)) bins. Minimize SHA256(protocol_id|date|treated_id|control_id), exclude treated security. Match without replacement within cutoff; missing match remains missing. Same clocks, size and costs.
controls.non_movers: Keep ALL eligible signals and outcomes, including eventual non-movers, nonfills, rejected/missing/halts and losses. Future mover status is label-only, never candidate or matching input.
controls.cash: Zero market exposure and zero hypothetical interest/fees.

chronology.warmup: At least20fullprior sessions before first eligible date; no warmup outcomes scored.
chronology.inspection_registry: Before any empirical read, per-security/event/date registry records prior access, result inspection, purpose and hashes. Any known inspected reserved case is ineligible for reserved evaluation; no substitute dates/symbols selected by results. Missing registry blocks reserved access. These calendar names do not assert globally unseen public data.
chronology.previously_inspected: 2021Q1 ETF control permanently inspected, never a new holdout. Earlier LEAN/AAPL2020 and FB/META2022samples are diagnostics/development only. No existing outcomes were selected to choose these thresholds.
chronology.walk_forward: If development training is later introduced, native skfolio1.2.9 WalkForward(train_size=252,test_size=63,purged_size=6,reduce_test=True) splits SESSION rows; all securities/events for a session remain grouped. v1 rules have no fitted selector.
chronology.purge: All training label_end/exit times must be strictly before first evaluation decision; remove any shared issuer-event group from training. Six-session gap is a coarse aid, not sufficient proof. At each segment end censor any horizon crossing that boundary.
chronology.embargo: Strictly forward training only; never train on future-side rows. No extra future-side embargo is asserted. Cross-segment issuer/event groups stay excluded from earlier training.
chronology.trial_policy: Exactly2hypotheses x5arms; baseline selected a priori, no grid search or best-lane switch. Preserve each stress combination separately (leverage1/2/4 x impact10/50bps x latency60/300s,12perarm/lane); never choose favorable stress variant.
chronology.freeze: Protocol/code/input hashes and per-segment candidate selections retained exclusively before future labels/returns load. Reserved pass occurs once after validation gate; failed/inspected runs remain in ledger, never called untouched on rerun.

promotion.scope: Permission to proceed to a separately reviewed paper-candidate experiment only, never automatic paper/live orders.
promotion.mechanical: Zero late-source, same-bar, unknown-identity or corporate-action leakage; exact cash/fees/dividend/split reconciliation; all trial records retained; no unresolved exit, funding or delisting outcomes.
promotion.quality: Required historical universe/catalyst/quote/action coverage known for100% of scored candidate sessions; any unknown remains outside qualified sample and its count/selection implications reported. No market-wide completeness claim from selective exclusions.
promotion.performance: Validation AND reserved baseline must have positive net total return, drawdown<=20%, and mean net return excess over matched controls with simultaneous lower confidence bound>0. Both declared lanes retained even if one fails.
promotion.uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed20260920 circular moving blocks of5consecutive session-level paired excess-return means; preserve same-date cross-sectional dependence. Two lanes use97.5%two-sided per-lane intervals (Bonferroni family>=95%); no ordinary IID per-trade interval. Missing paired sessions are retained and fail minimum match coverage.
promotion.stress: At1x gross,50bps impact and300s delay net totalreturn>=0. Other stress paths, including2x/4x margin failure, reported without gating a favorable leverage selection.
promotion.extreme_label_claim: At least30positive cases and100negative cases per named +200%label per evaluation segment before any recall/precision claim; otherwise descriptive counts only and insufficient_evidence. No threshold relaxation after seeing rarity.
promotion.reject_or_defer: Any mechanical failure rejects current version. Insufficient sample/coverage or unknown inspection history defers empirical promotion. Negative validation rejects before reserved access. Positive synthetic mechanics never satisfy empirical gates.

references.role: Item1.01 is a material definitive agreement; filing timing and event date do not establish our information availability.
Stock bar interval starts, condition filtering and zero-volume documentation; historical mapping is retrospective.
Chronological native session splitter; independent interval/group checks still required.
Existing LEAN execution-model integration reference, not calibration or new execution proof.

implementation_scope: Minimal synthetic availability, candidate threshold, named label, entry timing and split/leakage checks only. Full feature construction, real PIT data, portfolio fills/accounting, matching, bootstrap inference and empirical promotion are NOT implemented by this contract exercise.
